result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback and portions of the preferred position: affiliates and contractors are expressly covered, and the licence is transferable to M&A successors. The changes are confined to the licence scope and preserve unrelated commercial terms. It does not fully reach the preferred position because the licence may end upon any termination permitted by paragraph 4, rather than only for an uncured material breach, and it is not made perpetual if intended to be a paid-up licence. Drafting is generally workable, but the retained revocation language and cross-references to sections 3, 4, and 9(h) should be reconciled.
